turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale. My son found his zero on his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who made that decision, and on what basis?
Don't manage me, Hale. Was Owen heard before that zero went into the gradebook, yes or no?
But I'm not changing the grade.

"Not changing the grade." I'm writing that down, and you still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen first. Your own procedure, 4.2, says a parent is contacted before any mark is entered, so either you show me what you have or I'm in the principal's office when we're done.
I'm still not changing it. Keep going if you like.

"Keep going if you like." Procedure 4.3 says software alone doesn't establish anything, so I'll ask once: what else do you have besides that checker? If the answer is nothing, I'm going upstairs today, and then to the board.
You can say it ten more ways. The answer is no.

Then you'll put that no in an email to me tonight, cc the principal, with the basis for it. Nobody heard Owen, nobody called me, and nobody has shown me a single page. I'm going upstairs the moment we're done here, Hale.
